description: Investigate Roblox's fragmented public web data from one agent-friendly CLI.

novel_features.name: User investigation bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble a public Roblox user's identity, avatar, groups, badges, inventory visibility, and thumbnails in one result.

novel_features.name: Group due diligence
novel_features.description: Resolve a Roblox group, its owner, roles, and other public context in one command.

novel_features.name: Creator catalog footprint
novel_features.description: Summarize a Roblox creator's public games, bundles, and catalog-facing identity in one result.

novel_features.name: Game ecosystem map
novel_features.description: Build a game-centered view of public universe details, creator context, media, and related badges.

novel_features.name: Relationship overlap
novel_features.description: Find shared public groups and relationship records between two locally synced Roblox users.
